title: Auth and local connector control-plane convergence

phases.objective: Move Local Manager desktop command schema ownership out of request paths, bind the table to governed migration and least-privilege runtime grants, classify session authority failures as bounded readiness responses, and use connector credential fallback only for explicit credential rejection.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated activation and Local Manager client
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Activation session writes, desktop command polling, and local connector dispatch through injected runtime dependencies
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Missing schema or DML authority produces a bounded non-secret readiness response, governed recovery owns schema and grants, and connector fallback succeeds only after a credential-invalid primary response without masking transport or provider failures.
steps: Exercise activation session access-denied classification and require a structured 503 that requests SELECT, INSERT, and UPDATE grants without exposing the database identity.
Inspect desktop command schema readiness without executing request-time CREATE or ALTER statements.
Validate the repository-owned migration, checksum-bound recovery execution binding, and runtime bootstrap grant contract for SELECT, INSERT, and UPDATE only.
Validate the read-only activation surface manifest exposes lifecycle metadata while excluding payload, result, request context, execution detail, and error text.
Exercise connector authentication with primary success, credential-invalid fallback success, both credentials rejected, forbidden, timeout, provider failure, and missing-token cases.
Require sanitized fallback telemetry and successful-credential preference without returning or logging credential material.
Run recovery policy and staging readiness regressions without applying a migration, changing a live grant, calling a provider, deploying, or mutating Production.
Require activation session-context diagnostics to remain read-only by default and prove the diagnostic path performs no session INSERT when no explicit write opt-in is supplied.
Require Staging runtime census to include local_manager_desktop_commands and its connector identity dependencies, with SELECT-only authority on alias/config identity tables.
Probe the connector public data plane and authenticated /policy path separately; public reachability must not be treated as authenticated command health.
When Cloudflare control-plane tunnel status conflicts with a successful connector data-plane probe, retain both timestamped sources and make data-plane reachability authoritative.
Expose only bounded Local Manager polling error metadata: code, requestId, retryable, retry_after, and surface; never copy the raw response body or secret material.

Run an isolated MariaDB 11.4 certification with a dedicated runtime principal to prove migration, least-privilege grants, enqueue, poll, claim, complete, expiry, activation projection, and denial of DELETE/CREATE/ALTER.
Claim queued desktop commands atomically with a unique claim token and bounded lease, then return only rows owned by that token.
Renew active claim leases through an authenticated heartbeat and require the same claim token for terminal completion.
Require explicit user approval in the Windows client when requires_user_confirmation is true.
Accept captured ChatGPT URLs only over HTTPS and only for chatgpt.com or its true subdomains.
Bind the MariaDB certification job result and evidence SHA-256 into canonical E2E evidence.
Require login and session restoration to remain read-only until an explicit Approve device gesture submits the displayed pairing fingerprint.
Prove possession of the ephemeral P-256 device key over the exact session, code, poll-token hash, and server challenge before issuing a device JWT.
Verify public pairing preview excludes session internals, identity, IP address, User-Agent, and arbitrary metadata.
Generate a P-256 device proof in .NET 8 using explicit RFC3279 DER encoding and verify that exact signature through the production Node verifier.
Bind explicit browser consent to the fingerprint of the exact public key that will be used for device proof-of-possession.
Read the local_app_releases registry without request-time schema or seed mutation and surface registry degradation when migration or seed state is unavailable.
assertions: HTTP request handlers perform read-only schema inspection and never create or alter local_manager_desktop_commands.
The runtime principal receives only SELECT, INSERT, and UPDATE on local_manager_desktop_commands in both governed target overlays.
CREATE, ALTER, DELETE, DROP, GRANT OPTION, schema ownership, and migration execution remain outside runtime authority.
Activation session table-access failures are bounded 503 responses with no SQL text, username, credential, or secret leakage.
Credential fallback is attempted only for an explicit credential-invalid response and never for 403, timeout, abort, transport, or 5xx failures.
The successful credential choice is preferred for later operations and fallback usage is observable only through sanitized metadata.
The activation surface is read-only and excludes command payloads, results, execution details, request context, and free-form error messages.
CI performs no live database mutation, migration apply, grant apply, provider mutation, external send, deployment, restart, or Production mutation.
The activation projection status taxonomy exactly matches the desktop command database enum and uses queued rather than pending.
Staging runtime readiness fails closed when local_manager_desktop_commands, local_connector_device_aliases, or local_connector_user_configs are absent or unreadable.
The connector repair surface cannot report healthy from public /health alone; authenticated command health must pass independently.
A reachable connector with rejected command credentials is classified as credential-binding degradation and must not trigger a blind reinstall.
Tunnel metadata/data-plane conflicts are explicit evidence conflicts rather than an unconditional down verdict.
Local Manager renders bounded structured backend diagnostics without raw response bodies, command payloads, credentials, or tokens.
The disposable MariaDB certification mutates only its isolated CI database, proves the exact runtime privilege envelope, and explicitly forbids Production or live Staging apply.
Concurrent pollers cannot both receive the same queued command; only the poller whose atomic update persisted claim_token may receive it.
Completion requires status=claimed, the exact live claim_token, and an unexpired claim lease; terminal states are immutable.
Enqueue TTL applies before claim, while long-running execution is protected by an independently renewed claim lease.
requires_user_confirmation is enforced by a fail-safe Yes/No desktop prompt before command execution.
ChatGPT URL capture rejects HTTP and suffix-confusion hosts such as evilchatgpt.com.
Canonical E2E evidence cannot report MariaDB certification success without the certification evidence file and SHA-256.
Opening a pairing link while signed in cannot approve the device without an explicit click after reviewing an immutable preview.
A proof signed by any key other than the key bound at pairing start, or using a mismatched challenge, is rejected.
Browser User JWTs are session-only, and credential-bearing responses truthfully declare that they are unsafe to log.
Windows and Node explicitly use the same ECDSA DER wire format; the cross-runtime certification rejects IEEE-P1363 input.
Changing the device public-key fingerprint invalidates the previously displayed pairing_fingerprint.
The Local Manager update route never executes CREATE TABLE or INSERT against local_app_releases.

phases.objective: Apply and read back the governed desktop-command migration and least-privilege grants in live Staging, certify the direct Custom-GPT connector credential path, and close the existing Admin MCP catalog schema gap through independently governed apply/readback.
Certify the desktop command lifecycle on disposable MariaDB 11.4 under an exact least-privilege runtime principal, including activation projection, expiry, and privilege denial.
Keep any Production canary blocked until Staging migration, grant, route, and rollback evidence is independently approved.
Production mutation remains disallowed by this pull request and requires the governed Production promotion path after Staging certification.
